decision: Textured all-angle sci-fi snowmobile matching the adjacent concept image. Deliver first as a stationary visual prop, not a working vehicle; provisional size is 5.49 wide x 13.80 long x 5.5 high studs. The source is one 286,769-triangle mesh with two 2048 WebP maps. A textured 25% reduction retains the skis, front body, handlebars and rear track, so preserve that source-derived shape in nine sub-10k meshes with 1024 PNG maps.
